nodes.label: hills-smudge-art.jpg

nodes.label: Overcast cloudy sky

nodes.label: Impasto / smudge brushwork
nodes.description: Visible thick directional strokes and paint texture; painterly smudge aesthetic matching filename hills-smudge-art

nodes.label: Alpine landscape painting
nodes.description: Classical mountain-lake-forest composition; impressionistic rather than photorealistic rendering

nodes.description: Quiet, remote, contemplative alpine atmosphere; soft overcast light without harsh contrast
